_comment: File-ownership manifest for a feature lane. sdlc-dispatch reads it to decide
which lanes may run at the same time. Prose in plan.md cannot grant ownership;
owns        required, non-empty. Repo-relative globs. Use a static directory
prefix ('src/auth/**') rather than a bare pattern ('*.ts'), because
a pattern with no directory prefix is treated as a catch-all and will
read_only   optional, default false. A read-only lane never conflicts.
Two lanes conflict when their static directory prefixes overlap or one contains
the other. The check is deliberately conservative: it may defer a lane that would
in fact be safe, and it will never admit two lanes that might touch the same file.
